title: Betafpv Cetus X FPV Ready to Fly Kit Brushless Quadcopter US$206.67 (~A$309.55) Delivered @ Global RC Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: Betafpv Cetus X FPV Ready to Fly Kit Brushless Quadcopter US$206.67 (~A$309.55) Delivered @ Global RC Store AliExpress

[RichardL] OP which set are you posting for?
ELRS Kit 4B
ELRS Kit 4B 1C
ELRS Kit 8B 1C
[MasterYeeter] ELRS Kit 4B
Apologies for the broken link
[RichardL] Thanks for confirming, updated deal with coupon code.
[spirrowhack] 5 minutes flight time seems a bit low (I don't know anything about these devices).
[Exorior] 450mAh battery is laughably small! Most FPV drones are between 800-1500.
[MasterYeeter] This drone uses 2 batteries at the same time. So 450mAh × 2.
I think these are compatible with some of the larger 680mAh Lava 2 batteries as well.
[Exorior] Oh nice, thats good then. Thanks for the info :)
[High] Too many ORs. The listing seems to be for the Cetus kit which uses frsky protocol, not the more popular ELRS
[MasterYeeter] Cetus X uses the better ELRS protocol I believe. Updated description to reflect this.
[High] Ah the "Color" points to the ELRS variant. My bad.
[Yanoflies] If I have a Radiomaster Boxer Crush, what would be a good kit to get started? I got it a year or two ago but never found the time to actually get started lol.
I'll put in some hours with a sim but a small, cheap, mostly hassle free to setup and maintain thing I can learn IRL would be nice.
[High] Very good price, drops to around $235 after coupons and cashback. You've listed the coupon so the price in title should be updated to reflect that.
[MasterYeeter] I think the price was updated by a Mod to include GST and after applying the coupon code. Great reminder to use cashback!
[High] Upon checking this listing is not eligible for cashback :(
[scottySK] should a beginner grab this or an air65/air75? Would love to hear from people who are into this hobby
